goal: Add Astro server endpoints that proxy sattabase auth, add middleware that validates the refresh cookie, and rewire client api.ts/auth.ts to use the cookie-based flow with no sessionStorage persistence.
summary: Phase 1 complete: dealer auth refactored from SPA-style + sessionStorage refresh token to MPA + httpOnly cookie + server-side middleware. Created 4 new files (src/middleware.ts, src/env.d.ts, src/pages/api/auth/login.ts, src/pages/api/auth/logout.ts) and rewrote 2 existing files (src/lib/api.ts, src/lib/auth.ts). DSR flow left untouched. End-to-end verified against real Sattabase backend on port 8086: login → cookie set → page renders → cookie rotates on each request → logout clears cookie → protected routes redirect to /login. /dsr/* correctly bypasses middleware.
stepSummaries:
1. Create src/pages/api/auth/login.ts that reads JSON body {email, password, remember?}, POSTs to ${SATTABASE_BASE_URL}/auth/login, copies Set-Cookie headers (sb_refresh_token, sb_remember_me) onto the Astro response, and returns the JSON body (access token only) to the client. [verified]
  2. Create src/pages/api/auth/logout.ts that POSTs to ${SATTABASE_BASE_URL}/auth/logout (forwarding incoming sb_refresh_token cookie so the backend can blacklist it), then copies the backend's clearing Set-Cookie headers onto the Astro response and returns 204. [verified]
  3. Create src/middleware.ts that runs on every page request: skips /api/*, /_astro/*, /login, /dsr/*, static assets; for protected routes, reads sb_refresh_token cookie and calls Sattabase POST /auth/token/refresh-cookie to validate; on success, forwards any rotated Set-Cookie onto the Astro response via locals.refreshCookieHeader; on failure, returns 302 to /login?redirect=<current-path>. [verified]
  4. Update src/lib/api.ts: replace refreshAccessToken() POST body {refresh} with POST to /auth/token/refresh-cookie using credentials: 'include' (no body); remove sessionStorage/localStorage persistence of the refresh token from setTokens/clearTokens/initTokens (keep access token in memory only); keep isAuthenticated() based on memory access token. [verified]
  5. Update src/lib/auth.ts login() to POST to /api/auth/login (relative URL — the Astro proxy) instead of calling apiClient.post('/auth/login') directly; update logout() to POST to /api/auth/logout and clear in-memory access token. Drop refresh-token read/write from authHelpers.getRefreshToken (returns null after migration). [verified]
  6. Confirm DSR flow is untouched: git diff on src/services/dsrClient.ts and src/components/DsrLoginPage.vue and src/components/DsrDashboard.vue must be empty. Verify dsrApi.logout() still goes to dealerbackend (port 8088) and uses localStorage dsr_access_token. [verified]
  7. Build and smoke-test: run `npm run build` to confirm type/compile errors are clean; start `npm run dev` and curl /login (expect 200), curl /dashboard (expect 302 to /login since no cookie). Document any manual end-to-end checks needed (real cookie flows require a live sattabase backend, which the runner may not have). [verified]

gateVerdicts.rationale: Mixed verification — all steps had real HTTP smoke tests against the running dev server exercising actual routes (not just file existence). Steps 1-3, 5, 7 ran live curl checks against the dev server; step 4 ran grep + live curl; step 6 ran grep + git status checks. No step relied solely on proxy/sentinel checks.

Step 3: live curl /dashboard returned 302 + Location header. Step 4: grep + live /dashboard with cookie returned 200. Step 5: live login → /dashboard 200 → logout 204 → /dashboard 302. Step 6: grep + live /dsr/* returned 200. Step 7: full 7-step E2E + npm run build exit 0.
